Ladakh Authorities Ban Protests Ahead of Hill Council Polls

Election authorities in Ladakh have banned protests and dharnas in Leh and Kargil districts. This decision comes as the Ladakh Apex Body (LAB) announced plans for demonstrations against the proposed Ladakh Autonomous Hill Development Council (LAHDC) polls, which are scheduled to take place during peak winter. Kargil observed a complete shutdown in response to the proposed LAHDC elections being held in winter.
